# Scoreboard

Best verified runs per benchmark: official verifier, full shots, status PASS, one line per circuit (the run with the most salts). **Includes public circuits we verified ourselves**, so a row here is not necessarily ours; the provenance of each is in [PROVENANCE](../PROVENANCE.md). Ratio is `baseline_cost / worst-salt cost`. Cost is the official cost; `toffolis` is a static count and not the cost.
